answer.description: Short reveal at the top of the card back, e.g. 'The Lion!'

didYouKnow.description: The highlighted strip pinned to the bottom of the card back.

facts.description: One or two extra facts in the middle of the card back. One short simple sentence each, for a 10-year-old.

front.description: Question prompt shown on the front of the flip card.

id.description: Unique inside the topic, e.g. lion

fallbackImage.description: Bundled local image used when there is no network, e.g. assets/lion.jpg. This is the offline fallback.

image.description: Primary image URL — a direct free stock photo URL (e.g. images.unsplash.com). Must be preflight-checked: returns HTTP 200 and shows the right subject.

lottie.description: Optional free Lottie animation URL (lottiefiles CDN). Hides gracefully when it fails to load.

video.description: Optional short muted looping free stock video URL. Hides gracefully when it fails to load.

correct.description: Indexes (0-based) of the correct options. One entry = single-answer question; two or more = multi-answer question, and 'multi' must be true.

hint.description: Optional small hint shown under the question, e.g. 'pick 2'.

id.description: Unique inside the topic, e.g. q1-king-jungle

multi.description: True when more than one option is correct. The point is earned only for an exact match.

options.description: Answer options in display order. Short options (14 chars or fewer) render in a 2-column grid; if any option is longer, all options stack one per row.

text.description: The quiz question. For multi-answer questions add '(pick 2)' at the end.

icon.description: One emoji shown on the topic tile, e.g. 🦁

id.description: Lowercase, hyphens only, e.g. amazing-animals. Never rename an id once published — progress and stars are keyed on it.

description: Content file for Wonder Kids GK. Topics, learn cards and quiz questions live in content.json in the repo; the app fetches it at load and falls back to its bundled copy when offline. This schema is the contract every content.json must follow.

version.description: Bump by 1 every time the content changes, so the app knows a fresh copy is available.

title: Kids GK Quiz — Content Schema
